request: Move internal/account's three tables (accounts, tesla_tokens, vehicles) into a dedicated `account` Postgres schema. Tier 1 of RM39 — the pilot tier every later tier mirrors.

tasks.title: Goose migration — CREATE SCHEMA account + ALTER TABLE ... SET SCHEMA (x3), with reversing Down
Schema-qualify every table reference in internal/account/db/query.sql
sqlc.yaml gen.go.rename block + make sqlc + verify models.go type names unchanged
Docs — internal/account/AGENTS.md and any doc naming these tables
Verification — go build / go vet / gofmt -l, boundary + no-other-module checks, openspec validate --strict

decisions.decision: Database design gate PASSED: schema named `account`, additive SET SCHEMA migration, reversing Down, no index changes
decisions.why: Owner asked whether the account_account stutter could be avoided; the rename block is required for ANY non-public schema, so a different name buys nothing and breaks schema==module.

decisions.decision: No new to_regclass catalog test; rely on the existing account integration suite
decisions.why: A failed schema move makes every account query fail, so the existing suite already catches it. Matches the owner's no-extra-tests default.
